correctness.rationale: For fixed old alternating matrix \(B\) of rank \(2s\), bordering by \(x\) preserves rank exactly when \(x\in\operatorname{im}B\), and otherwise adds one nondegenerate alternating plane, increasing rank by two. Thus exactly \(q^{2s}\) borders preserve rank and the remaining \(q^n-q^{2s}\) raise it, giving the recurrence by partitioning the old rank strata. The argument is valid in characteristic two. The inspected verifier exhaustively checks every graph on at most four vertices over \(\mathbf F_2,\mathbf F_3\) and the stated small tripartite formulas, corroborating the symbolic proof.

final_claim: If \(\widehat\Gamma=K_1\vee\Gamma\) and \(\rho_i\) counts specializations of the edge-supported alternating matrix of rank \(2i\), then \(\rho_i(\widehat\Gamma;q)=q^{2i}\rho_i(\Gamma;q)+(q^n-q^{2i-2})\rho_{i-1}(\Gamma;q)\) for \(i\ge1\), with \(\rho_0=1\); consequently polynomial character-degree enumeration is closed under coning, including the displayed explicit \(K_{1,a,b}\) formula.
limitations: Universal-vertex coning only; no analogous formula is claimed for arbitrary joins.
